articles.summary: International Paper has received the 2026 World's Most Ethical Companies® recognition by Ethisphere, a global leader in defining and advancing the standards of ethical business practices.IP has been recognized 20 times and is the only honoree in the Forestry, Packaging & Paper industry. IP is one of six organizations that has been recognized 20 times. In 2026, 138 honorees were recognized spanning 17 countries and 40 industries.
